errors.evidence: The description incorrectly transcribes a legend label as 'Сегмент на държавни ценни кинжа' (Segment of government daggers), when the correct label is 'Сегмент на държавни ценни книжа' (Government securities segment). The word 'кинжа' is incorrect and nonsensical in this context.

The description qualifies the base segment as 'the largest' ('най-големият'), which is an interpretive comparison of the relative sizes of the stacked components within a bar. The prompt explicitly asks to avoid making comparisons.
